question: Which of the following is known as the Flying Sikh of India?
solution:
__Milkha Singh__ was called the ‘Flying Sikh’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• He is a former Indian track and field sprinter who had been introduced to the sport while serving in the Indian Army.
 
• He was the only Indian athlete to win an individual athletics gold medal at a Commonwealth Games until Krishna Poonia at the 2010 Commonwealth Games won the gold medal for the discus.
 
• In recognition of his sporting achievements, he was awarded the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian honor.
 
• He represented India at the Melbourne Summer Olympics of 1956, at the Rome Summer Olympics of 1960 and at the Tokyo Summer Olympics of 1964.
 
• He was a former Indian track and field sprinter.
 
• He won Gold Medal in 1958 and 1962 Asian Games.
 
• He finished at 4th place in the 1960 Rome Olympic.
 
• He was awarded Padma Shree for his contribution to the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The "Flying Sikh" nickname he acquired from General Ayub Khan of Pakistan after defeating Abdul Khaliq in Pakistan in 1960.

 
 
• Milkha Singh is the first person from India to win a Gold medal in Individual athletics at the Commonwealth Games. 
 
• He also won two gold medals in the Asian Games in 1958 and 1962.
 
• He has represented India in the three Summer Olympics such as the one in 1956 at Melbourne respectively in 1960 at Rome and in 1964 at Tokyo.
 
 
• The Indian government has honoured him by awarding the fourth-highest civilian award Padma Shri for his achievements in sports.
 
 
 
• Milkha won over Abdul Khaliq, the Pakistani Athlete in **1960** during the 200m event at an **International Athletic competition in Lahore**.
 
• The then General Ayub Khan, commented post-race stating him as **"Flying Sikh"**.
